game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Summit Spire, the highest spire: the mountaineer must hold off snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the radio mast.
theme: Frost Peaks – Summit Spire: the highest spire
core_gameplay_loop: In Summit Spire, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the radio mast. Then check vault_keys and advance.
player_objective: Protect the radio mast from snow leopards in Summit Spire: keep vault_keys above zero until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 8, Level 7, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
